name: Backend maintenance release

# Code-only Global releases preserve the existing production configuration and
# schema. Feature activation and schema changes use the production release flow.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_sha:
        description: Full SHA at the tip of protected beta
        required: true
        type: string
      previous_production_sha:
        description: Full SHA currently serving production
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: castreader-backend-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.25.0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Fetch the protected release ref
        run: git fetch --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/beta:refs/remotes/origin/beta'

      - name: Verify immutable release source
        run: pnpm release:verify-source
        env:
          CASTREADER_RELEASE_APPROVED: '1'
          CASTREADER_RELEASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          CASTREADER_PREVIOUS_PRODUCTION_SHA: ${{ inputs.previous_production_sha }}
          CASTREADER_PRODUCTION_GIT_REF: origin/beta

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:tts-gateway
      - run: pnpm test:voice-clone-contract
      - run: pnpm test:tts-monitoring

      - name: Configure PostgreSQL migration-test binaries
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          postgres_bin="$(pg_config --bindir)"
          test -x "$postgres_bin/initdb"
          test -x "$postgres_bin/pg_ctl"
          test -x "$postgres_bin/psql"
          echo "$postgres_bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - run: pnpm test:google-play-recovery
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-migration
      - run: pnpm test:tts-runtime-migration
      - run: pnpm test:tts-production-migration-gate
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-request-migration
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-v1-migration
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-guest-draft-migration
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-request-locale-migration
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-request-expiry-migration
      - run: pnpm test:voice-gift-guest-draft-release
      - run: pnpm exec tsx --test scripts/voice-gift-candidate-e2e.test.ts
      - name: Verify upload and CN regional isolation regressions
        run: pnpm exec tsx --test src/shared/upload-gateway/*.test.ts src/shared/lib/cn-regional-assets.test.ts src/core/redis/cn-regional.test.ts
      - run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144

      - name: Capture and verify the current production baseline
        id: baseline
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          baseline_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-baseline.json"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
            --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --header 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
            "https://api.castreader.ai/api/capabilities?release_probe=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-baseline" \
            --output "$baseline_file"
          node - "$baseline_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const valid =
            manifest.commitSha === process.env.EXPECTED_PREVIOUS_SHA &&
            /^dpl_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(manifest.releaseId || '') &&
            manifest.voiceClone?.version === 'voice-clone-v3' &&
            manifest.voiceClone?.serviceRoute === 'global' &&
            manifest.voiceClone?.clients?.web?.join() === 'global' &&
            manifest.voiceClone?.clients?.extension?.join() === 'global' &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.version === 'voice-gift-v1' &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.libraryVersion === 'voice-library-v1' &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.enabled === true &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.releaseEnabled === true &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.schemaReady === true &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.draftSchemaReady === true &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.draftFlow?.version === 'voice-gift-draft-v1' &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.recipientRequiresPro === false &&
            manifest.voiceGift?.synthesisRequiresPro === true;
          if (!valid) {
            console.error('production baseline is not eligible for a configuration-preserving maintenance release');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `release_id=${manifest.releaseId}\n`);
          NODE
        env:
          EXPECTED_PREVIOUS_SHA: ${{ inputs.previous_production_sha }}

      - name: Install pinned Vercel CLI
        run: npm install --global vercel@59.9.1

      - name: Pull and audit the existing Global production configuration
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test ! -e .env.local
          vercel pull --yes --environment=production
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/assert-global-vercel-target.ts -- \
            --project-file .vercel/project.json \
            --env-file .vercel/.env.production.local
          test ! -e .env.local
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}

      - name: Build one immutable configuration-preserving candidate
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test ! -e .env.local
          vercel build --prod
          test ! -e .env.local
          if grep -R -I -q '/vercel/path0/.env.local' .vercel/output; then
            echo 'candidate artifact captured forbidden root .env.local'
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          CASTREADER_GIT_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}

      - name: Deploy the candidate without assigning production domains
        id: deploy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          deployment_url="$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --skip-domain --yes)"
          case "$deployment_url" in
            https://*.vercel.app) ;;
            *) echo 'deployment did not return an exact Vercel candidate URL'; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "url=$deployment_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}

      - name: Verify candidate contracts preserve the production baseline
        id: candidate_capabilities
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          candidate_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-candidate.json"
          vercel curl /api/capabilities --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- \
            --silent --show-error --fail --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
            --output "$candidate_file"
          node - "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-baseline.json" "$candidate_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const { isDeepStrictEqual } = require('node:util');
          const baseline = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const candidate = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
          if (
            candidate.commitSha !== process.env.EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA ||
            !/^dpl_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(candidate.releaseId || '') ||
            candidate.releaseId === baseline.releaseId ||
            !isDeepStrictEqual(candidate.voiceClone, baseline.voiceClone) ||
            !isDeepStrictEqual(candidate.voiceGift, baseline.voiceGift)
          ) {
            console.error('candidate changed an existing production capability or release identity is invalid');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `release_id=${candidate.releaseId}\n`);
          NODE
          for endpoint in /api/voice-clone/voices /api/voice-clone/voices/vc_capability_probe/preview /api/voice-clone/requests /api/voice-clone/shares /api/voice-clone/library; do
            status="$(vercel curl "$endpoint" --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}')"
            test "$status" = 401
          done
          for endpoint in /api/voice-clone/captioned-speech /api/captioned_speech_partly; do
            status="$(vercel curl "$endpoint" --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --request POST --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"input":"probe","voice":"vc_capability_probe"}')"
            test "$status" = 401
          done
          inspection="$(vercel curl /api/voice-clone/requests/invitation --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- --silent --request POST --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"token":"invalid-capability-probe"}')"
          node -e 'const b=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); if(b.code!=="VOICE_GIFT_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND") process.exit(1)' "$inspection"
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify the Google Play cron is authenticated and non-cacheable
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-cron-headers.txt"
          status="$(vercel curl /api/cron/google-play-reconcile --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- \
            --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
            --dump-header "$headers_file" --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}')"
          test "$status" = 401
          node - "$headers_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const headers = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
          if (!/^cache-control:\s*[^\r\n]*\bno-store\b/im.test(headers)) {
            console.error('Google Play reconciliation response must be non-cacheable');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify both RTDN formats without claiming a purchase
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for format in wrapped unwrapped; do
            payload="$(node -e '
              const notification = {subscriptionNotification: {
                purchaseToken: `synthetic-release-probe-${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
                notificationType: 2
              }};
              process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(process.argv[1] === "wrapped"
                ? {message: {data: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(notification)).toString("base64")}}
                : notification));
            ' "$format")"
            response="$(vercel curl /api/pro/google-webhook --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL" -- \
              --silent --show-error --fail --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
              --request POST --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$payload")"
            node -e '
              const result = JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);
              if (result.ok !== true || result.reason !== "unknown_purchase") process.exit(1);
            ' "$response"
          done
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install ffmpeg for candidate audio validation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update --quiet
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends ffmpeg
          ffmpeg -version

      - name: Verify TTS sentence boundaries against the exact candidate
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/probe-tts-sentence-boundaries.mts -- --deployment "$CANDIDATE_URL"
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Voice Gift authenticated and guest E2E against the exact candidate
        id: candidate_e2e
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          attestation_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/voice-gift-maintenance-e2e"
          raw_attestation="$attestation_dir/raw.json"
          release_attestation="$attestation_dir/release-attestation.json"
          mkdir -p "$attestation_dir"
          printf '%s\n' '{"status":"not_started"}' > "$release_attestation"
          test -s .vercel/.env.production.local
          test -n "$EXPECTED_BILLING_AUTHORITY_FINGERPRINT"
          test "${#VOICE_GIFT_E2E_BRIDGE_SECRET}" -ge 32
          command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null

          set +e
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/voice-gift-candidate-e2e.mts -- \
            --base-url "$CANDIDATE_URL" \
            --github-run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --env-file .vercel/.env.production.local > "$raw_attestation"
          e2e_status="$?"
          set -e

          if test "$e2e_status" -ne 0; then
            node - "$raw_attestation" "$release_attestation" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const [rawPath, outputPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
          let code = 'candidate_e2e_failed';
          try {
            const result = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(rawPath, 'utf8'));
            if (result.status === 'failed' && /^[a-z0-9_]{1,128}$/i.test(result.code || '')) {
              code = result.code;
            }
          } catch {}
          fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, `${JSON.stringify({ status: 'failed', code })}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
          NODE
            exit "$e2e_status"
          fi

          node - "$raw_attestation" "$release_attestation" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const [rawPath, outputPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
          const result = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(rawPath, 'utf8'));
          const requiredPhases = [
            'fixtures', 'reference_audio', 'request_created', 'anonymous_inspection',
            'claimed', 'voice_created', 'fulfilled', 'library', 'preview', 'clone_tts',
            'revoked', 'revocation_enforced', 'guest_invitation', 'guest_prepare',
            'guest_preview', 'guest_fulfill', 'guest_library', 'guest_tts',
            'guest_revoke', 'guest_cleanup', 'cleanup',
          ];
          const candidateHost = new URL(process.env.CANDIDATE_URL).hostname;
          const phases = Array.isArray(result.phases) ? result.phases : [];
          const valid =
            result.status === 'passed' &&
            result.githubRunId === process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID &&
            result.candidateHost === candidateHost &&
            result.databaseAuthority === 'global-approved' &&
            result.databaseSchema === 'verified' &&
            result.cleanup === 'verified' &&
            Number.isInteger(result.appendOnlyAuditEvents) &&
            result.appendOnlyAuditEvents > 0 &&
            requiredPhases.every((phase) => phases.includes(phase));
          if (!valid) {
            fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, '{"status":"failed","code":"candidate_attestation_incomplete"}\n', { mode: 0o600 });
            console.error('candidate E2E attestation is incomplete');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          // Only the explicitly allowlisted, non-secret attestation fields leave
          // the runner; raw output and the Vercel environment file are not uploaded.
          fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, `${JSON.stringify({
            status: 'passed',
            releaseSha: process.env.EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA,
            previousReleaseId: process.env.PREVIOUS_RELEASE_ID,
            githubRunId: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID,
            githubRunAttempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,
            candidateHost,
            e2e: {
              status: 'passed',
              githubRunId: result.githubRunId,
              candidateHost,
              phases: requiredPhases,
              appendOnlyAuditEvents: result.appendOnlyAuditEvents,
              databaseAuthority: 'global-approved',
              databaseSchema: 'verified',
              cleanup: 'verified',
            },
          })}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
          NODE
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          PREVIOUS_RELEASE_ID: ${{ steps.baseline.outputs.release_id }}
          EXPECTED_BILLING_AUTHORITY_FINGERPRINT: ${{ vars.EXPECTED_BILLING_AUTHORITY_FINGERPRINT }}
          VOICE_CLONE_WEB_BRIDGE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.VOICE_CLONE_WEB_BRIDGE_SECRET }}
          VOICE_GIFT_E2E_BRIDGE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.VOICE_GIFT_E2E_BRIDGE_SECRET }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}

      - name: Preserve the redacted candidate E2E attestation
        if: ${{ always() && steps.candidate_e2e.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: voice-gift-maintenance-e2e-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/voice-gift-maintenance-e2e/release-attestation.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Recheck production has not moved before promotion
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          current_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-pre-promotion.json"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
            --header 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
            "https://api.castreader.ai/api/capabilities?release_probe=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-pre-promotion" \
            --output "$current_file"
          node - "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-baseline.json" "$current_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const { isDeepStrictEqual } = require('node:util');
          const baseline = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const current = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
          if (
            current.releaseId !== baseline.releaseId ||
            current.commitSha !== baseline.commitSha ||
            !isDeepStrictEqual(current.voiceClone, baseline.voiceClone) ||
            !isDeepStrictEqual(current.voiceGift, baseline.voiceGift)
          ) {
            console.error('production baseline moved while candidate verification was running');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

      - name: Promote the verified artifact
        id: promote
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The CLI may fail after an alias has moved. Record the attempt before
          # calling it so an ambiguous result is still eligible for recovery.
          echo 'attempted=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          vercel promote "$CANDIDATE_URL" --yes
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Wait for promoted production alias convergence
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          consecutive_matches=0
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            manifest_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-production.json"
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
              --header 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
              "https://api.castreader.ai/api/capabilities?release_probe=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-$attempt" \
              --output "$manifest_file" &&
              node - "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-candidate.json" "$manifest_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const { isDeepStrictEqual } = require('node:util');
          const expected = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const live = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
          const valid =
            live.releaseId === expected.releaseId && live.commitSha === expected.commitSha &&
            isDeepStrictEqual(live.voiceClone, expected.voiceClone) &&
            isDeepStrictEqual(live.voiceGift, expected.voiceGift);
          process.exit(valid ? 0 : 1);
          NODE
            then
              consecutive_matches=$((consecutive_matches + 1))
              if test "$consecutive_matches" -ge 3; then
                echo 'production alias converged to the verified candidate'
                exit 0
              fi
            else
              consecutive_matches=0
            fi
            if test "$attempt" -lt 30; then sleep 3; fi
          done
          echo 'production alias did not converge to the verified candidate' >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Verify TTS sentence boundaries on production aliases
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/probe-tts-sentence-boundaries.mts -- --base-url https://api.castreader.ai

      - name: Verify production aliases
        run: pnpm release:probe-voice-clone
        env:
          CASTREADER_EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}

      - name: Inspect final deployment
        id: verify_deployment
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          vercel inspect "$CANDIDATE_URL"
          echo 'verified=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          CANDIDATE_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

      - name: Restore the original complete production artifact if verification fails
        if: ${{ always() && (failure() || cancelled()) && steps.promote.outputs.attempted == 'true' && steps.verify_deployment.outputs.verified != 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # No env mutation and no same-code disabled artifact: restore the exact
          # complete deployment captured before this maintenance release began.
          # The concurrency group excludes other approved workflows, but not a
          # manual promotion. Never overwrite an independently changed release.
          current_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-before-rollback.json"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
            --header 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
            "https://api.castreader.ai/api/capabilities?release_probe=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-before-rollback" \
            --output "$current_file"
          rollback_action="$(node - "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-baseline.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-candidate.json" "$current_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const [baseline, candidate, current] = process.argv.slice(2).map((path) =>
            JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'))
          );
          if (current.releaseId === baseline.releaseId && current.commitSha === baseline.commitSha) {
            console.log('verify_baseline');
          } else if (current.releaseId === candidate.releaseId && current.commitSha === candidate.commitSha) {
            console.log('restore_baseline');
          } else {
            console.error('production changed to an unrelated release; refusing automatic rollback');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE
          )"
          if test "$rollback_action" = restore_baseline; then
            vercel promote "$PREVIOUS_RELEASE_ID" --yes
          else
            test "$rollback_action" = verify_baseline
            echo 'production still points to the original artifact; verifying without mutation'
          fi
          consecutive_matches=0
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            manifest_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-rollback.json"
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
              --header 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
              "https://api.castreader.ai/api/capabilities?release_probe=$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-rollback-$attempt" \
              --output "$manifest_file" &&
              node - "$RUNNER_TEMP/backend-maintenance-baseline.json" "$manifest_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const { isDeepStrictEqual } = require('node:util');
          const expected = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const live = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
          const valid =
            live.releaseId === expected.releaseId && live.commitSha === expected.commitSha &&
            isDeepStrictEqual(live.voiceClone, expected.voiceClone) &&
            isDeepStrictEqual(live.voiceGift, expected.voiceGift);
          process.exit(valid ? 0 : 1);
          NODE
            then
              consecutive_matches=$((consecutive_matches + 1))
              if test "$consecutive_matches" -ge 3; then
                echo 'original production artifact restored and verified'
                exit 0
              fi
            else
              consecutive_matches=0
            fi
            if test "$attempt" -lt 30; then sleep 3; fi
          done
          echo 'original production artifact restoration could not be verified' >&2
          exit 1
        env:
          PREVIOUS_RELEASE_ID: ${{ steps.baseline.outputs.release_id }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
